route.title: Why a nuclear ship?
route.text: With chemical rockets each trip takes about 7 months, and the radiation there and back would go over the limit for an astronaut's whole career. With nuclear propulsion each trip takes about 4 months: that is why NASA is studying this idea to take people to Mars.
